verdict.rationale: The evidence shows vLLM loads Hugging Face models, supports GGUF and other quantized formats, and offers a Transformers modeling backend. None of it documents where downloaded weights or caches are stored, or whether other runtimes can reuse them without re-downloading or re-converting. Format and model-support claims belong to a different story and do not establish cache or file reuse across runtimes.

support.subject: As a developer, I know whether downloaded model files and caches can be reused by other runtimes without re-downloading or re-converting them
